reverse.target: Derived by this stage from FR16.1 and requirements OQ-B: the target must exist, must not be deleted or pending deletion, and must not be the requester; no AC names the target's state.
Derived by this stage: at most one live grant per (agent, target); no AC names it.
Derived by this stage: approval is eligible for 60 minutes after the request; no AC names it.

notes: C5's `denied` status is dropped (question Q3) because no requirement defines a deny action; recorded as an open contract item in functional-spec.md.

The metadata read moves to the `/v1/support-grants/{grantId}/metadata` surface (question Q1) and aggregates from two new internal endpoints owned by the Account and Portfolio services; both are open dependencies, not delivered by this unit.

AC3.4.1 has two halves. The API half — no support endpoint returns, reads or resets a credential or a holding — is BR3.10 and is delivered here. The screen half — no credential column in the console — is U9 (u9-support-console-ui, metadata panel) and U10 (u10-admin-users-ui, admin users list) presentation and is traced in those units.
